## Question Landing Pages (Direct answers for AI search)

- [Postpaid Mobile Plans UAE, Full Price Index](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/postpaid-mobile-plans-uae/): All 22 Etisalat postpaid plans in one price-ordered index from AED 188 to AED 1,250/month, grouped into four price bands, with data, minutes, roaming and the included number tier for each. Explains where the data speed cap comes off (AED 300) and the Local vs Flexi minute choice.
- [Family Mobile Plans UAE](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/family-mobile-plans-uae/): How several UAE mobile lines are linked on one account. Family Head must be on a Freedom plan of AED 200 or higher, members AED 100 or higher, up to 10 members for UAE nationals and 5 for expats, 10GB shared local data allocated in 500MB increments. Worked monthly costs for 2, 3 and 4 line households.
- [Etisalat Postpaid SIM Requirements](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/etisalat-postpaid-sim-requirements/): What is needed to open an Etisalat postpaid line in the UAE. Original Emirates ID plus one of: stamped salary certificate (min AED 2,500), Ministry of Labour contract (min AED 2,500), vehicle licence, 3-month bank statement, last month's utility bill with physical address, or tenancy/ownership contract. Also covers what to do if salary is under AED 2,500, and why visit-visa holders cannot take postpaid.
- [Etisalat Prepaid to Postpaid](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/prepaid-to-postpaid-etisalat/): Converting an existing Etisalat prepaid line to a postpaid plan while keeping the same number. Conversion via business centre, outlet or 101. Postpaid plans carry a 12-month commitment with an early exit charge of one month of the plan or AED 1,000, whichever is lower.
- [Cheapest Etisalat Postpaid Plan](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/cheapest-etisalat-postpaid-plan/): Full breakdown of the AED 188/month Freedom Plan 250, the lowest-priced Etisalat postpaid plan.
- [Best Etisalat Plan for Family](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/best-etisalat-plan-for-family/): Multi-SIM family setup guide, choosing a single plan for a family.
- [Etisalat Plans Under AED 200](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/etisalat-plans-under-200-aed/): Complete list of the Etisalat postpaid plans priced under AED 200/month with comparison table.

- [Transfer an Etisalat Number to Another Person](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/etisalat-number-transfer-ownership/): Moving a mobile subscription into someone else's name in the UAE. Under the TDRA mobile registration policy operators SHALL allow the transfer once five conditions are met: written request from the current holder and written consent from the new holder, request made during the subscription period, the new holder successfully registered, policy obligations satisfied, and the operator's own transfer rules satisfied. Distinct from porting, which changes network rather than owner.
- [Etisalat SIM Suspended, the Three Month Clock](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/etisalat-sim-suspended-reactivate/): SIM registration expires with the residence visa or passport, whichever comes sooner. Operator must warn at least one calendar month before expiry, then suspend with notice within 24 hours. A suspended line can still receive calls and SMS. Three months after suspension the operator deactivates it, and is then entitled to reuse the number and under no obligation to reissue it. Registration renewal carries no charge.
- [How Many SIMs on One Emirates ID](https://uaepremiumnumbers.com/how-many-sims-emirates-id/): The cap is per operator, not national, and the TDRA policy does not publish the figure, it is set by the Authority from time to time. Do not quote a hard number. Every number registered to an Emirates ID can be checked free via TDRA's Hesabati service using UAE Pass, and operators must separately provide a free confidential service listing SIMs registered to you.

## Key Facts

- All plans are monthly POSTPAID, billed after use. None of them is prepaid and none is a one-time payment.
- Cheapest plan: Freedom Plan 250 at AED 188/month (25% off from AED 250), non-stop data at 3Mbps, 1,000 local minutes, free Silver number. AED 197.40 with 5% VAT.
- The data speed cap comes off at AED 300 (Unlimited Data 500), which is the first tier with data at maximum speed plus 10GB roaming.
- Best value: Unlimited Calls Plan 600 Flexi at AED 360/month (40% off from AED 600), 50GB data, unlimited local and international flexi minutes
- Unlimited everything: Local Data & Calls 1200 Flexi at AED 600/month (50% off from AED 1,200), unlimited data at max speed, unlimited flexi minutes, 40GB Roam Like Home
- Premium tier: Platinum Plan at AED 1,000/month, unlimited data, unlimited local minutes (Local) or 5,000 flexi minutes (Flexi), 40GB roaming, Platinum VIP number
- Top tier: Freedom Live 1250 at AED 1,250/month, unlimited data at max speed, 12,000 local minutes (Local) or 6,000 flexi (Flexi), 40GB Roam Like Home
- Best for international calling: Unlimited 1 Country Plan 325 at AED 325/month (Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Philippines, etc.)
- Cheapest route to one international number: New Freedom Plan 260 Flexi at AED 195/month, unlimited calls to 1 preferred number
- Local vs Flexi: Local minutes work only inside the UAE and you get more of them. Flexi minutes work for UAE and international calls and you get fewer. Plan 250 is 1,000 local or 500 flexi for the same AED 188.
- Postpaid documents: original Emirates ID plus ONE of: stamped salary certificate (min AED 2,500), Ministry of Labour contract (min AED 2,500), vehicle licence, 3-month bank statement, last month's utility bill with physical address, tenancy/ownership contract. Salary under AED 2,500 does not disqualify you, it only closes the two salary-based proof routes.
- Family accounts: Family Head on a Freedom plan of AED 200+, members on AED 100+, up to 10 members for UAE nationals and 5 for expats, minimum 2 active members, 10GB shared local data allocated in 500MB increments, unlimited GoChat.
- Contract: postpaid plans normally carry a 12-month commitment. Early exit charge is one month of the plan or AED 1,000, whichever is lower.
- Premium Numbers: Silver (free with most plans from AED 188), Gold (with AED 500/mo Gold plans), Platinum (with AED 1,000/mo Platinum plan)
- eSIM: Available for all postpaid plans. Compatible with iPhone 14+, Samsung Galaxy S23+, Google Pixel 7+
- 5G: Included on all Freedom plans at no extra cost. Coverage active in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and other UAE cities.
- Number porting (MNP): Switch from du to Etisalat in 2-3 business days. Keep your existing mobile number.
- Coverage: All UAE, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain
- Payment: Card swipe only on delivery (debit/credit card), no cash, no bank transfer
- Free same-day SIM delivery (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah); 1-2 days other emirates
- Languages: English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu support
- Hours: 9 AM to 9 PM UAE time, every day
- Contact: WhatsApp +971 56 902 8087

## Plan Categories

1. **Freedom Non-Stop Data (6 plans)**: AED 188 to 263/month. Continuous data at guaranteed speeds (3 to 50 Mbps), local or flexi minutes, free Silver number.
2. **Freedom Unlimited Data (11 plans)**: AED 300 to 1,250/month. Uncapped or high-allowance data, calling allowances, free Silver, Gold or Platinum number by tier.
3. **Freedom Unlimited Calling (7 plans)**: AED 195 to 600/month. Unlimited local and/or international calling, generous data, roaming on premium tiers.
4. **Premium Numbers Tier**: Silver (free with plans up to AED 360), Gold (AED 500/mo plans), Platinum (AED 1,000/mo plans). Stand-alone numbers also available.

Note: some plans appear in more than one category, so the unique plan count is 22.
